case_title: BORRUSO MERLE VS PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC CO

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $350.00 FILED BY BORRUSO MERLE AS TO DEFENDANT PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC CO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-15-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BORRUSO MERLE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC CO STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
